description: Public pre-LLM AisleCheck deterministic baseline: structured interpretation, catalog entity resolution, clarification, and historical assessment.

deployed_branches.render_backend_note: Render serves deploy/aislecheck-catalog-entity-resolution tip 0096b89. Activation commit 44ff557 only flips public FE flag/cache; backend entity-resolution and assessment code are present at 0096b89.

preexisting_unrelated_failures: tests.test_canonical_families: week expectation 2026-07-08 vs 2026-07-29; multi_family popular refs empty — homepage popular week only, not AisleCheck runtime

known_limitations: Week-level ad history only (not daily shelf scrapes).
Safeway and Vons history series are never mixed in assessment.
Some trackers have sparse or empty comparable weeks → insufficient_data / limited_data.
Clarification answers are still reparsed as free text; loop fingerprints prevent identical non-progress loops.
Shopper aliases do not change weekly-ad YAML include matching.
Apple Jacks and similar absent products are unsupported (protected from wrong heuristics, not inventing trackers).
Production instrumentation for full metric reporting is not yet live; production metrics marked unavailable until collected.
Untracked local packages (holdout_labeler, deal_assistant tooling) must not be required by the production API path.
